name: Avatar Expressions - Study 2
author: san_jk
description:
The study must be in full-screen mode.

 48 images depicting a virtual character expressing an emotion will be shown to you for 5 seconds, and you will then have to answer two questions about your impressions regarding the emotional expression from looking at the image. First, you must identify the expressed emotion and then rate how effective the expression is at depicting the selected emotion. You do not need to take more than 5 seconds to answer questions for each image. The estimated completion time is 10 minutes. 

 Thank you for participating!!
